snapshot.how: both inputs are read at a NAMED REF with `git show`; the dashboards modules are extracted from the ref file by file (following relative imports) into a temp dir and imported from there, so the domain map is the product's own composer output rather than a transcription. Re-dump rather than hand-edit.
snapshot.displayRules: every count on the boards is either the composer output recorded here or explicitly badged fixture; no figure is transcribed from prose

register.countingRule: one row per job, from the Homes tables in _inbox/2026-08-17_g18_shell_homes.md (primary 31 + review-product 7 + products 6 + feeds 12 + other 11 = 67 source rows); a source row that bundled jobs with different dispositions is split into one row per job, each naming its source row in splitFrom

caseSearchAnchor.basis: RECORD_ENVELOPE_FIELDS declares recordId a required identifier on every record of every kind, so every case in every region is reachable by it without the finder assuming anything per region

documents.countingRule: DISTINCT smart_file_documents.id via smart_file_placements WHERE target_type='folder' AND target_id=folderId
documents.coverageCountingRule: documents with a current version in scope: searched = current version has search_text; every not-searched row is counted once under the reason recorded on its current version, or under reason-not-recorded when none was recorded
searchIndexBases: search_text is present on the current version
the reason recorded on the version row when it was uploaded
the row predates search_index_reason; the reason is not recorded and is not inferred from content_type
documents.searchSignature: export async function searchDocuments(scopeType, scopeId, q)

derived.outcomeVocabularyBasis: DOMAIN_STATUSES from src/fixture-seam.mjs, READ_REFUSAL_CODE from smart-files src/identity.mjs, and searched/not-searched from the two counts in smart-files emptyCoverage() countingRule

legs.label: Cases
legs.reads: DOMAIN_REGISTRY, the regions the department lenses read
legs.anchor: recordId, which RECORD_ENVELOPE_FIELDS makes required on every record of every kind
legs.predicate: the recordId of a case in a region whose gating adapter is granted on this pack; any further field the finder matches on is a DESIGN decision named on the board, not a product guarantee

legs.label: Documents
legs.reads: the Smart Files corpus for this city tenant
legs.predicate: the current version of a document whose search_text matches the query

notALeg.why: a parcel is a place, not a record; the top-bar placeholder names three nouns and only two of them are records. Wiring the third is a place-lookup change and is named as an acceptance item, never changed quietly here
